name: jotview
description: Turn markdown and Mermaid diagrams into rendered jotbins.com links, and read jotbins links back.
long_description:
Ask Claude for notes, a report or a Mermaid diagram "as a jotbins link" and get a link that opens the page, fully rendered, on jotbins.com. Small documents live entirely inside the link; larger ones are uploaded to surl.jotbins.com for a short link (deleted after 30 days without a visit unless kept). Claude can also read any jotbins link you paste.

Optionally pick a docs folder so Claude can render .md/.txt files from it without pasting them.

tools.name: render_markdown
tools.description: Turn markdown into a rendered jotbins link

tools.name: read_link
tools.description: Get the markdown behind a jotbins link

docs_dir.title: Docs folder (optional)
docs_dir.description: Claude may render .md, .markdown, .mdx and .txt files from this folder by path. Leave empty to turn file access off.
